As it winds its way through the densely wooded landscape you may see otters, deer, or even an occasional moose. As you float slowly through Vermont farmland you'll be awed by the views of Camel's Hump Mountain. The Winooski is a bird watchers paradise. services.name: Snowshoe & Tubing Tour
services.desc: 3 Hours About A sledding and snowshoe adventure! We will provide the snowshoes, sleds, snacks and a guide. You provide the energy and the passion for some fun and adventure. Your guide will take you on a snowshoe through easy wooded nature trails and see a panoramic mountain view. Then, snowshoe over to our sledding hill! We'll take multiple runs by snowshoeing up and sledding down. This adventure is perfect for the whole family. WHAT TO BRING o Winter ski jacket and pants o Fresh Pair of Wool or polypropylene socks o Insulated footwear (Umiak rents NEO over boots for added warmth) o Bring out the kid in you!

services.name: Sugar On Snow-Shoe Tour
services.desc: Appropriate footwear for this activity will depend on the weather conditions. In snowy and icy conditions, participants will be provided with snowshoes or other equipment designed to provide traction Taste the Sweetness of Winter

services.name: Moonlit Maple Snowshoe Tour
services.desc: 3 Hours About Embark on a captivating adventure with our professional staff as they guide you to a secret sugarhouse nestled in the enchanting woods. Allow yourself to be immersed in a warm and cozy ambiance accompanied by the delightful aromas of toasty fire and delectable Cabot cheese with crackers and Runamok maple syrup. Savor the exquisite taste of hot, mulled Cold Hollow apple cider to complete this unforgettable night, or bring along your own bottle of wine to enhance your Tap into Tradition

services.name: Gourmet Fondue Snowshoe Tour
services.desc: 3 Hours and 30 minutes About Immerse yourself in the wildness of Vermont’s winter landscape on our evening gourmet fondue snowshoe tour. Our expert guide will lead you on a forest trek by the glow of headlamps and light of the moon. Experience the natural habitat of many local animals- keep your eyes peeled for tracks in the powder. The tour ends at the Field Guide Lodge where you will enjoy an intimate dining experience with your party. This three-course meal features soup as well as locally-produced Vermont Cabot Cheese fondue and Lake Champlain Chocolate fondue. WHAT TO BRING o Delicious & Fun!

services.name: Backcountry Ski Tour
services.desc: 6 Hours About Choose your equipment: lightweight telemark equipment or AT equipment This guided instructional tour will bring you to some of Stowe's premier backcountry on a full-day instructional ski adventure. Choose the equipment you would like to ski on during your tour, lightweight 75mm 3-pin telemark equipment or AT equipment. Umiak’s certified backcountry guide will teach proper safety protocol and the necessary safety gear needed before heading into the backcountry. Learn valuable skills in applying, removing, and storing climbing skins or caring for fish scale backcountry Intermediate or experienced Participants!

services.name: Intro to Nordic Ski - Instruction
services.desc: Join our Introduction to Nordic cross-country ski class for beginners. The class includes instruction on ski techniques, proper gear, safety, and local trail information. Our expert instructors provide feedback and personalized tips to improve students' skills. This introductory class is perfect for anyone looking to get some exercise and explore the great outdoors in the winter months! Cross-country ski equipment and trail fee is included in the Perfect For Beginners!

services.name: Nordic Ski Tour
services.desc: 4 Hours About Kick and glide through Vermont's most amazing backcountry scenery. Our Nordic backcountry ski packages, NNNBC or the new Xplore system, are perfect for lightweight travel and responsive downhill performance. Our expert ski guides will lead you through rolling hills and beginner and intermediate backcountry trails on stable metal-edged skis. Cross-country ski equipment and trail fee is included in the price. We can customize the program to meet the ability level of your group. We have a variety of tour locations to ensure the best snow conditions possible. WHAT TO BRING Ski Beyond Boundaries
